title: Young musicians today and electric guitars in the union
summary: Scott laments that young players only learn the scale and the union is full of guitarists.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: It makes you feel kind of lonesome, because these young kids coming up, they don't appreciate music like the older ones. They were dedicated to their instruments and all like that. These young fellows just want to learn how to play the scale, and they think they know music upside down. Don't tell them nothing. Learn the scale.
And in the books at 802, there's more guitars listed than anything else. Electric guitars. Half of them don't know how to play them. But you pay $75, you can join.
